en.name: Textile fragment from the shrine of San Librada, Sigüenza Cathedral
description: This textile fragment displays a pattern of roundels bearing addorsed griffins with gazelles below their forelegs, within a border of pairs of fantastic animals. The interstitial motif consists of an eight-pointed star enclosing a rosette and surrounded by pairs of confronted quadrupeds. The pattern, popular in both Muslim and Byzantine worlds, recalls earlier silks of the eastern Mediterranean and, ultimately, of Central Asia. Silks of this type have been found in reliquaries of churches in Spain; they may be the "patterns with circles" of Almeria referred to in historical documents. These Islamic textiles were most likely brought to Sigüenza by Alfonso VII, in 1147 on the occasion of the victory over the Almoravids and the capture of Almeria.
dates: Hegira late 5th–first half 6th century / AD first half 12th century
keywords: Taifa; Spain; texile; fragment; silk; lampas weave; griffon; gazelle; Almohad; religious object; Byzantine influences

en.name: And We Did Not Send You But as a Mercy of All Beings
description: In his practice, Haji Noor Deen employs, develops and further interprets Sini calligraphy. The Sini style, which emerged in the 14th century AD, fuses Chinese and Arabic calligraphic traditions. Born in 1963 in Shangdong province, China, Haji Noor Deen graduated from Egypt Sadat Calligraphy School and obtained his calligraphy *ijaza* in Istanbul. This work is made of patterned teal silk with mounted calligraphy on paper. The Arabic calligraphy with the 21st sura of the Qur'an is contained by a thin, circular golden line. The words are arranged in such a way that they seem to spin outwards from a 10-armed spiral. The title of the work appears in black ink on the left, next to two red seals. A third red seal appears on the top right.
materials: Ink and red seal colour on rice paper, mounted on silk
tags: Ink and red seal colour on rice paper, mounted on silk
partner: Museum of Islamic Art at the Pergamon Museum, State Museums

en.name: Variation of the Basmala
description: This calligraphic work is made of patterned silver-white silk with mounted calligraphy on paper. The Arabic calligraphy in black, brown, purple-blue and teal ink forms the shape of water in a vase, and expands into flower stems. Flowers and leaves are painted in green, red, black and teal ink; the centre of the largest flower is marked with a small, elongated shape filled with gold. The title of the work is written in black ink on the left, above two red seals. A third red seal appears on the top right.
materials: Ink and red seal colour on rice paper, mounted on silk
tags: Ink and red seal colour on rice paper, mounted on silk
partner: Museum of Islamic Art at the Pergamon Museum, State Museums

ar.name: وُريدة.
description:
وُريدة من الجبس المنحوت، لها عشرة بتلات مطليّة بالأزرق على خلفيّة حمراء اللّون. لم يتبقّ من اللّون الأزرق إلا أثر ضئيل على حافّة بتلة واحدة. ويبدو أن القسم المركزي كان مطليّاً بالأصفر، وذلك لأنّ قطعاً أخرى من الجبس تمّ العثور عليها في نفس المكان وكانت مطليّة بالأزرق والأحمر والأصفر. وزوال الألوان مرتبط بفعل العوامل الطبيعيّة من ضوء وهواء.  
لم تكن هذه الورُيدة، دون أدنى شك، إلا عنصراً تابعاً لإفريز من الجبس يحمل الألوان الثلاثة ( الأزرق والأحمر والأصفر)؛ أو ربّما كانت، كما يؤكّد ج. مارسي، ملصقة على ركنيّة قوس.

قطعة من الجبس المنقوش تمثل وريدة ذات عشر بتلات مصبوغة في بداية الأمر باللون الأزرق حول التويجة التي ربما كانت مطلية بالأصفر، فوق خلفية حمراء. فقد كانت هذه الوريدة تشكل جزءا من إفريز من الجبس المتعدد الألوان إلا أن هذه الأخيرة قد انقرضت.
keywords: إفريز؛ بني حمّاد؛ جبس؛ زخرفة زهريّة؛ وُريدة.

en.name: Rosette.
description:
Decorative rose patera or rosette in sculpted plaster composed of ten petals in blue on a red background. All that remains of the blue is a tiny trace on the edge of a petal. The central part would have been painted in yellow, as other plaster fragments discovered at the same place were painted in blue, red and yellow. The disappearance of the colour is due to the natural effects of light and air.  
This rose patera was no doubt just one element belonging to a plaster frieze that featured three colours (blue, red and yellow); or perhaps, as is affirmed by Marçais, it was placed on the cornerstone of an arch.

Sculpted plaster piece representing a ten-petal rosette, originally painted blue, around a corolla, which may have been painted yellow, all on a red background. The colours have not survived well. This rosette would have been part of a multicoloured plaster frieze.
keywords: Rosette; floral decoration; plaster; frieze; Hammadid; palatial architecture; architectural decoration
partner: National Museum of Antiquities and Islamic Art

es.name: Rosetón.
description:
Rosetón decorativo de yeso esculpido con diez pétalos y pintado en azul sobre fondo rojo. Del color azul no perdura más que un ínfimo rastro en el borde de un pétalo. La parte central debió de estar pintada de amarillo, pues otros pedazos de yeso descubiertos en el mismo lugar lo estaban de amarillo, azul y rojo. La desaparición del color se debe a los efectos naturales de la luz y el aire.  
Este rosetón no era, sin duda, más que un elemento perteneciente a un friso de yeso pintado en tres colores (azul, rojo y amarillo) o, quizá, como afirma Marçais, estuviera insertado en la albanega de un arco.

Rosetón decorativo en yeso esculpido con diez pétalos pintados en azul alrededor de la corola, que quizá estuvo coloreada en amarillo; el fondo del conjunto es rojo. Los colores están mal conservados. Este rosetón era parte de un friso en yeso policromo.
keywords: rosetón; decoración floral; yeso; friso; hammadíes
partner: Museo Nacional de Antigüedades y de Arte Islámico

fr.name: Rosace.
description:
Rosace décorative en plâtre sculpté à dix pétales peinte en bleu sur fond rouge. De la couleur bleue ne subsiste qu'une infime trace sur le bord d'un pétale. La partie centrale devait être peinte en jaune, car d'autres débris en plâtre découverts au même endroit étaient peints en bleu, en rouge et en jaune. La disparition de la couleur est due aux effets naturels de la lumière et de l'air.  
  
Cette rosace n'était sans doute qu'un élément appartenant à une frise en plâtre qui portait les trois couleurs (bleu, rouge et jaune) ; ou peut-être, comme l'affirme Marçais, était-elle apposée sur l'écoinçon d'un arc.

Pièce en plâtre sculpté représentant une rosace à dix pétales initialement peints en bleu autour de la corolle qui, elle, était peut-être peinte en jaune, le tout sur fond rouge. Les couleurs se sont mal conservées. Cette rosace faisait partie d'une frise en plâtre polychrome.
keywords: rosace ; décor floral ; plâtre ; frise ; Hammadides
partner: Le Musée national des antiquités et d’art musulman

de.name: Stuck
description: Der im Einzelmotiv schon recht spielerisch wirkende, im Gesamten sehr harmonisch und mit zurückhaltender Eleganz behandelte Wessobrunner Stuck trägt wesentlich zur Flächengliederung sowie Akzentuierung von Kanten, Gurtbögen Stichkappen bei, gelegentlich die Grenzen ein wenig überspielend. Außerdem werden die Freskenfelder eingefasst und so in ihrer Bedeutung gesteigert. Im Chor sind in das ornamentale Dekorationssystem darüber hinaus trophäenartig präsentierte Symbole von Kirche, Papsttum und Messfeier integriert.

en.name: Stucco
description: The stucco of the Wessobrunn school, whose individual motifs have a playful aspect and overall create a harmonious impression of restrained elegance, largely contribute to the structuring of planes as well as the accentuation of edges, vault arches, and lunettes, occasionally lightly masking the borders. In the choir, symbols of the church, the papacy, and the celebration of Mass, presented in a trophy-like manner, are integrated into the ornamental system of decoration.

en.name: Coffee-roasting spoon
description: In Oman, copper is a traditional material for making equipment related to the kitchen and dining room. Smiths still practice the trade along the coasts of al-Batinah and the interior; this spoon hails from the al-Dakhiliyah Governorate. Coffee-roasting spoons are one of the most important tools used in the preparation of Omani coffee in the *dallah* pot, where coffee beans are stirred until roasted and ready for grinding and boiling.
holder: The National Museum - Sultanate of Oman
place: Bahla, Al Dakhiliyah Governorate, Northern Oman

en.name: Fireplace mirror
description:
A type of console mirror for use above a fireplace, it has imitation legs in the form of flat scrolls. The mirror itself is octagonal, a richly carved frame of ornate C- and S-scrolls and pierced *rocaille* surround it.  
Two unidentified coats-of-arms, incorporated into the scrollwork, extend into candle stands from which two angels' heads peep out from the crest formed by shell ornaments.  
The mirror furnished the Hütterott family mansion on Crveni otok island, near Rovinj in Istria. A German family of merchants and industrialists from Trieste, their presence in Rovinj began in 1890 when Johann Georg Hütterott opened a climatic health resort there and bought nearby islets, the family playing a major role in the overall advancement of the Rovinj area.

The carved gilded frame decorated in a characteristically mid-18th century style, with C- and S-scrolls and pierced *rocaille* belongs to a type of mirror for use above a fireplace. It came from the mansion of the Hütterott family on Crveni otok near Rovinj, which today is a hotel. The merchant and industrialist Hütterott family from Trieste bought several islets near Rovinj in 1890. They advanced the whole Rovinj area, and among other things laid out an exceptional park in Rovinj itself.
place: From the manor of the Hütterott family on Sv. Andrija island, which after 1945, was renamed Crveni otok island near Rovinj, Istria.
keywords: Furnishing; glass; wood carving; pierce; gilding; polychrome decoration; Hütterott family; industry; trade

en.name: Church of S. Maria della Speranza
names: Church of Santa Maria della Speranza
description: The date of the church’s foundation is uncertain. The Norman structures are at the ground level of the building incorporating them. The entrance portal is clearly visible with double lintel, the two lateral windows beside it and one superincumbent, with various ornamental patterns, but all with a pointed outline. The internal lintel of the portal has zig-zag reliefs; the outside one has rounded ashlars. A double lintel with denticle folds outlines the windows along the sides of the portal. The single lancet window above the portal is formed by a cornice that closes a double archivolt with zig-zag patterns. An analysis of the nature of the carvings that have remained has, however, been sufficient to assign the foundation of the church to the period of Guglielmo II (1166-1189).

es.name: Iglesia de Santa María de la Esperanza (opción)
description: No se sabe a ciencia cierta la fecha de su fundación. Las estructuras normandas están en la planta baja del edificio que las engloba. Se reconocen claramente la puerta de entrada con doble arco, las dos ventanas laterales que la flanquean y una encima, con motivos ornamentales diversos, pero todas de arco apuntado. El arco interior de la puerta tiene relieves en zigzag; el exterior, sillares almohadillados. También las ventanas dispuestas a los lados de la puerta están marcadas por un arco doble, con pliegues en dentellón. El *monóforo* de encima de la puerta está delimitado por un marco que encierra un doble arco con motivos en zigzag. El análisis de la naturaleza de la talla de estos restos ha sido suficiente, en todo caso, para asignar la fundación de la iglesia al periodo de Guglielmo II (1166-1189).

it.name: Chiesa di Santa Maria della Speranza

en.name: *Armed Guard of a House*
short_description: Painting by Eduard Charlemont showing an Egyptian guard in front of a door. Charlemont graduated from the Academy of Fine Arts in Vienna and travelled widely. He specialized in painting in the Oriental style.
keywords: Charlemont; Oriental style

en.name: First issue of *Al-Ahram*
short_description:
*Al-Ahram* was founded in Alexandria in 1875 by two Lebanese brothers, Bishara Takla and Salim Takla. It began as a weekly newspaper published every Saturday. Its first issue appeared on 5 August 1876. The paper was relaunched as a daily newspaper in January 1881.  
Its headquarters was in Alexandria until November 1899 when it was moved to Cairo. The newspaper was distributed in Egypt and the Levant. The religious innovators Muhammad Abduh and Jamal al-Din al-Afghani were early writers of the newspaper. Upon the death of Bishara Takla, Dawud Barakat, a Lebanese journalist, was named editor of the daily in 1901.

ar.name: طقم من كوز وحوض.
description:
يتألف الطقم من قطعتين: كوز وحوض كان يستخدم للوضوء. الحوض كبير ويتسع تدريجياً نحو الخارج. والكوز على شكل إجاصة، وله قبضة منحنية وغطاء. تمت زخرفة حافة الحوض وجسم الكوز وغطائه والقسم السفلي من مصبه بمعينات محفورة بأخاديد دقيقة. كما أن الأخاديد الرأسية والأفقية للمعينات تعطي أشكالاً مربعة. ويتوج غطاء الكوز برعم ورد وورقة ينسجمان مع نمط ذلك العصر.  
  
اتبعت تقنية الطلاء بالذهب، المعروفة بالتومباك والنقش، في زخرفة الطقم. وقد ظهرت طريقة الطلاء بالذهب، خصوصاً في مصنوعات النحاس الصافي، في القرن 12 / 18. وهذا الأسلوب يستدعي تقنياً نشر مزيج من مسحوق الذهب والزئبق على سطح القطعة، ثم تعريضها لنار الأتون. وخلال الاحتراق يتبخر الزئبق بينما يلتصق مسحوق الذهب على السطح. وأحياناً توضع رقاقة ذهبية على سطح معدني مغطى بالزئبق، وحين يتبخر الزئبق خلال عملية الاحتراق، تلتحم رقاقة الذهب على القطعة.  
  
تخبرنا النقوش الموجودة على الكوز والحوض أن القطعتين مكرستان لضريح بيرتونيال الملكة الأم وتحملان تاريخ 1286 (1870). كانت بيرتونيال سعيدة الحظ الثانية للسلطان محمود الثاني (حكم في الفترة 1223- 1255 / 1808- 1839). وعندما أنجبت عبد العزيز، احتلت المرتبة النسائية الأعلى في البلاط؛ وحين اعتلى عبد العزيز العرش عام 1278 / 1861 أصبحت والدة السلطان، أي الملكة الأم. وأمرت ببناء مجمع باسمها في حي الأقصري في استنبول يشتمل على مسجد ومدرسة وسبيل ماء عمومي وخزان، وعلى ضريح بني من أجلها في فناء المسجد وضم جثمانها عندما توفيت عام 1300 / 1883. ويحتوي المتحف على قطع عديدة أخذت من هذا الضريح، من بينها القطع المعروضة هنا.

ظلّ الذهب التعبير الأول عن القوة الاقتصادية، في جميع مراحل التاريخ. و"التمبك" الذي هو خليط النحاس والزنك، مادة تُضفي ثوب الذهب على جملة من الأشياء، وهي مستخدمة لزخرفة هذين الإبريق والطست، اللذين كانت السلطانة الوالدة بيرتفنيال، أم السلطان عبد العزيز، تستخدمهما، في أثناء المناسبات والأعياد الدينية.
dates: يحمل كل من الكوز والحوض نقشاً يبين كل منهما أنهما مكرسان لضريح بيرتونيال، الملكة الأم ، ومؤرخان في عام 1286 / 1870.
keywords: تومباك؛ حوض؛ كوز.

en.name: Ewer and basin set.
description:
A set comprising two pieces: a ewer and a basin that was used for ritual ablution. The basin is large with a flaring rim. The ewer has a pear-shaped body, a curved handle and a lid. The flaring rim of the basin and the body, lid and lower part of the spout of the ewer are decorated with lozenges formed by small grooves. Vertical and horizontal grooves in the lozenges also form square motifs. On top of the lid are a flower-bud and leaf in keeping with the fashion of the time.  
  
The set is decorated in a gilding technique known as *Tombak* and engraved. In Turkish metalwork gilding, especially of pure copper artefacts, appears in the AH 12th / AD 18th century. Technically, this method of gilding involves spreading an amalgam of powdered gold and mercury on the surface of the object, which is then fired in a kiln. The mercury evaporates during the firing, while the gold powder adheres to the surface. Sometimes gold leaf is placed on a mercury-coated metal surface, and when the mercury evaporates during firing, the gold leaf is fixed to the object.  
  
The inscriptions on the ewer and the basin inform us that the objects were dedicated to the Tomb of Pertevniyal Valide Sultan, and they give the date of AH 1286 (AD 1870). Pertevniyal was the second *iqbal* (lit. 'fortunate one') of Sultan Mahmud II (r. AH 1223–55 / AD 1808–39). When she gave birth to Abdülaziz, she ascended to the highest female rank at court and when Abdülaziz ascended the throne in AH 1278 / AD 1861 she became the Valide Sultan (Mother of the Sultan, i.e. the Queen Mother). She had a complex built in her own name in the Aksaray Quarter of Istanbul. It comprised a mosque, a *maktab* (school), a *sabil* and a public fountain, and a tomb which was built for her in the courtyard of the mosque and in which she was buried when she died in AH 1300 / AD 1883. The Museum owns several objects taken from this tomb, some of which are in this exhibition.

Gold has been the expression of economic power in all periods of history. *Tombak* is a technique that gives the look of gold to items and is used to decorate this ewer and basin set used by Pertevniyal Valide Sultan, mother of Sultan Abdülaziz, during religious ceremonies.
holder: Museum of Turkish and Islamic Arts.
keywords: Tombak; ewer; basin; Pertevniyal Valide Sultan; Mahmud II; Abdülaziz.
materials: Gilded copper, known as the *tombak* technique.
tags: Gilded copper, known as the tombak technique.
partner: Museum of Turkish and Islamic Arts

es.name: Juego de aguamanil y jofaina.
description:
Juego de aguamanil y jofaina usados para la ablución ritual. La jofaina es grande y tiene el borde abierto hacia afuera. El aguamanil tiene forma de pera, asa curva y tapa. El borde de la jofaina y también el cuerpo, la tapa y la parte baja del pico del aguamanil están decorados con rombos formados por pequeñas muescas. Los rombos presentan, a su vez, pequeñas muescas horizontales y verticales que forman cuadrados. Encima de la tapa hay un capullo de flor y una hoja, propios de la moda de la época.  
El conjunto está grabado y dorado con una técnica conocida como *tombak*. El dorado, especialmente de los objetos de cobre puro, se introduce en la metalistería turca en el siglo XII / XVIII. Esta técnica consiste en extender una aleación de mercurio y oro en polvo sobre la superficie del objeto, que luego se cuece en un horno. Con el calor, el mercurio se evapora y el oro en polvo se adhiere a la superficie. Algunas veces se aplican panes de oro sobre el metal recubierto de mercurio; cuando el mercurio se evapora en el horno, la lámina de oro queda fijada al objeto.  
El aguamanil y la jofaina poseen inscripciones que informan de que estaban destinados a la tumba de Pertevniyal e indican la fecha de fabricación: 1286 / 1870. Pertevniyal fue la segunda *iqbal* (literalmente 'la afortunada') del sultán Mahmud II (r. 1223-1255 / 1808-1839). Cuando dio a luz a Abdülaziz, ascendió al rango femenino más alto de la corte y, con la llegada de Abdülaziz al trono en 1278 / 1861, se convirtió en Valide Sultan (o 'sultana madre'). Ordenó construir un complejo en su nombre en el barrio de Askaray de Estambul que comprendía una mezquita, un *maktab* (escuela) y fuentes públicas, así como una tumba para ella en el patio de la mezquita, donde fue enterrada a su muerte en 1300 / 1883. El museo posee varios objetos tomados de este sepulcro, algunos de los cuales están expuestos.

El oro ha representado al poder económico en todos los periodos de la historia. La técnica del *tombak* otorga aspecto áureo a los objetos, como a este juego de aguamanil y jofaina que Pertevniyal, madre del sultán Abdülaziz, usaba en las ceremonias religiosas.
holder: Museo de Arte Turco e Islámico.
keywords: Tombak, aguamanil, jofaina, Pertevniyal Madre del Sultán, Mahmud II, Abdülaziz.
tags: Tombak, aguamanil, jofaina, Pertevniyal Madre del Sultán, Mahmud II, Abdülaziz.

fr.name: Aiguière et son bassin.
description:
Ensemble constitué d'une aiguière et d'un bassin destiné aux ablutions rituelles. Le bassin de dimensions importantes présente un bord évasé. L'aiguière est à corps piriforme, poignée incurvée et couvercle. Le rebord du bassin, le corps, le couvercle et la partie inférieure du bec de l'aiguière sont décorés d'un rainurage formant des losanges à l'intérieur desquels des rainures verticales et horizontales constituent des motifs carrés. Le couvercle comporte à son sommet un bouton de fleur et une feuille, selon la mode de l'époque.  
L'ensemble fait appel à une technique de dorure appelée *tombak*. Dans le travail du métal turc, la dorure, en particulier d'objets en cuivre pur, apparaît au XIIe siècle H (XVIIIe siècle J.-C.). Cette méthode chimique consiste en l'application d'un amalgame de poudre d'or et de mercure à la surface de l'objet, qui est ensuite cuit dans un four. Le mercure s'évapore pendant la cuisson tandis que l'or adhère à la surface du cuivre. Des feuilles d'or peuvent aussi être appliquées sur la surface métallique mercurisée. à l'évaporation du mercure pendant la cuisson, les feuilles se fixent sur l'objet.  
L'inscription mentionne que ces objets étaient destinés au tombeau de Pertevniyal Valide Sultan et indique la date de 1286 / 1870 J.-C. Elle était la seconde *iqbal* (la favorite du sultan, littéralement “la fortunée”) du sultan Mahmoud II (r. 1223-1225 H / 808-1839 J.-C.). En donnant naissance au prince héritier Abdoulaziz, elle accéda au rang le plus élevé des femmes de la cour et lorsque son fils monta sur le trône en 1278 H / 1861 J.-C., elle devint Valide Sultan (mère du sultan). Elle fit construire un complexe de bâtiments à son nom dans le quartier d'Aksaray à Istanbul, comprenant une mosquée, une école et des fontaines publiques. à sa mort en 1301 H / 1883 J.-C., elle fut enterrée dans un tombeau aménagé dans la cour de sa mosquée. Plusieurs objets des collections du musée proviennent de ce tombeau.

L’or a été le symbole du pouvoir économique à toutes les périodes de l’histoire. La technique *tombak* est un procédé qui donne l’aspect de l’or aux objets. Elle est utilisée pour décorer cette aiguière et cette cuvette utilisée par Perteyniyal Valide Sultan, mère du sultan Abdülaziz, durant les cérémonies religieuses.
holder: Musée des arts turcs et islamiques.
keywords: tombak ; aiguière ; bassin ; Pertevniyal Valide Sultan ; Mahmoud II ; Abdoulaziz, Abdülaziz
partner: Musée des arts turques et islamiques

tr.name: Leğen-İbrik Takımı.
description:
Abdest almak için kullanılan leğen-ibrik takımıdır. Leğen büyük ve kenarları dışa dönüktür. İbriği armudi gövdeli, eğimli kulplu ve kapaklıdır. Leğenin dışa dönük kenarları, ibriğin tüm gövde ve kapağı, emziğinin alt kısmı yivlerle küçük baklavalara bölünmüş, içlerine bir dik bir yatay yiv açılarak ayrıca kareler oluşturulmuştur. Kapağın tepesinde dönemin modasına uygun tomurcuk ve yaprak vardır.  
  
Altın yaldızlı bakır (tombak) ve kazıma tekniği ile süslenmiştir. Türk maden sanatında, özellikle saf bakırın altın varakla yaldızlanması (tombak), 18. yüzyıldan sonra daha çok görülür. Kimyasal yöntemle yapılan kaplamada, altın tozunun cıvayla karışmasından oluşan amalgam, madeni yüzeye sürülerek fırınlanır. Isı ile cıva buharlaşırken, altın tozu esere yapışır. Daha kontrollü bir kaplama, istenilen kalınlıkta altın varaklarının cıva sürülmüş eser yüzeyine yerleştirilmesiyle elde edilir. Fırınlanan malzemedeki cıva buharlaşırken, varaklar eser yüzeyine yapışır.  
  
Leğen ve ibrikte Pertevniyal Valide Sultan türbesinde vakfedildiğini belirten yazı ve 1286 / 1870 tarihi yer alır. Pertevniyal, Sultan II. Mahmud' un (1223-1255 / 1808-1839) ikinci ikbaliyken, daha sonra tahta geçecek oğlu Abdülaziz'in doğumu ile beşinci kadın efendiliğe yükselmiştir. Abdülaziz'in tahta çıkmasıyla Valide Sultan oldu. Aksaray' da bir cami, mektep ve çeşme yaptırdı. 1883' de vefat etti. Kendi adı ile anılan caminin avlusunda bulunan türbesine defnedildi. Sergimizde bu türbeden müzeye getirilen çeşitli eserler yer almaktadır.

Altın her dönemde devletlerin ekonomik gücünün bir ifadesi olmuştur. 'Tombak'' tekniği, eşyalara altın görüntüsü verebilmek amacıyla kullanılan bir teknikti. Sultan Abdülaziz'in annesi Pertevniyal Valide Sultan'ın dini törenlerde kullandığı leğen-ibrik de tombak tekniğiyle oluşturulmuştur.
keywords: Tombak; leğen; ibrik; Pertevniyal Valide Sultan; II. Mahmud; Abdülaziz
materials: Bakır üzerine altın yaldızın kaplanmasıyla elde edilen tombak tekniğindedir.
tags: Bakır üzerine altın yaldızın kaplanmasıyla elde edilen tombak tekniğindedir.

en.name: House
short_description: In this house the influence of the Levantine architecture was coupled with the individual skills and talents of native architects, which has given rise to a diversity of types and outstanding autochthonous construction solutions. This three-storied house was built by use of the bondruk structural system, which consists of wooden framing and adobe. The façade is coated with mortar and decorated by application of a strip pattern on the band between the second and third storey, as well as above the top storey. It also has painted ornaments applied on the surface under the roof.
history: The most intense development of urban houses in Macedonia occurred in the 19th century, creating a new panorama of towns across the landscape. This applies particularly to the town of Veles, which reached the peak of its rise in the mid-19th century, owing to extensive growth of crafts and trade.
keywords: façade decoration

en.name: Cabinet on stand
description:
A large cabinet of the aedicule type standing on the base that belongs to it. In the shape of a horizontally oriented rectangle, and given frontal emphasis by its architectural appearance, its decoration of paintings on glass are framed by veneers of expensive woods – black ebony and tortoiseshell – materials that are also employed to build up the architectural decoration. Rosewood veneer covers the sides.  
The central aedicule with twisted pillars and gilt bronze fittings bears a fragmented gable, surmounted with painted fields organised to make up a lunette, and, in the lower zone, the decorative painting conceals a drawer for valuables incorporated into the architectural elements. The remainder of the front maintains rhythm and mobility by the recession of the central surface and projection of the architectural elements.  
The decorative repertoire of the glass, painted in tempera on the reverse, consists of figures and mythological scenes with the “*amour* of the gods” prevailing. There are also scenic views treated in the antique manner. Forms and landscapes in fresh colours immersed in silver and blue create refined tints and subtle tonal shading. The painted scenes are in the manner of Luca Giordano and more or less precisely repeat the iconographic motifs of his repertoire.  
The base is of richly carved and gilded wood constructed from luxurious, symmetrically conceived, front-facing vegetation – fleshy acanthus leaves powerfully mobilised in S-curves, and floral festoons enhanced with a central motif of mascarons, and figures of *putti*. Lion's-paw feet support the base.

A cabinet with the appearance of an architectural façade fitted with drawers for valuables. Richly decorated with painted glass panels framed with ebony and tortoiseshell, it stands on its own luxuriously carved and gilt base. The decorative repertoire of the glass compositions consist of figures, mythological scenes and views treated in the antique manner. The painted scenes are in the style of the Baroque painter, Luca Giordano.
keywords: Furnishing; Naples; workshop; glass; painting; gilded wood; gilding; mythology; floral decoration; Neaplitan painters

ar.name: جامع القيروان الكبير.
description:
تنتظم المعلمة ضمن مستطيل طوله 152 متراً وعرضه 75 متراً. يتألف التصميم من صحن ومن قاعة للصلاة يصل طولها إلى 137 مترا وعرضها إلى 37 متراً، قائمة على أعمدة، ومقسمة إلى سبعة عشر بلاطا وثمانية أساكيب. يحدد تقاطع البلاط الأوسط مع بلاط جدار القبلة مربعاً أمام المحراب، تعلوه قبة صغيرة ذات أخاديد تستند على حنيات ركنية مبنية من الحجر المنحوت، والتي استلهمت عناصرها الزخرفية مثل الأصداف والوردات المتعددة الفصوص من ما سبق من المجموعة الفنية الأموية.  
يشكل العدد الكبير للعواميد والتيجان القديمة لقاعة الصلاة وللأروقة المحيطة بالصحن، أكبر متحف للتيجان الرومانية والبيزنطية، والتي لم تجتمع قط في معلمة إسلامية أخرى. وقد حافظ السقف ذو الهيكل الخشبي لقاعة الصلاة، بالرغم من الترميمات المتتالية خلال القرنين 8 و11 الهجريين/ القرنين 14 و17 الميلاديين، على روافد خشبية جميلة ترجع للقرن 3 الهجري/ القرن 9 الميلادي. في حين، تبقى الزخرفة النباتية الشكل التي تزينها والمؤلفة من أشكال الفاكهة المدببة المغلفة بزخارف سعفات نخيل متناظرة، تجسيدا للأشكال المستوحاة من الزخرفة الهلينيستية.  
تعلو المحراب الذي يؤرخ لعصر أبي إبراهيم أحمد 247 هجري/ 862 ميلادي، نصف قبة من الخشب، المزوق بزخارف تتشكل من غصينات وأوراق ذات خمس فصوص. وزخرفت المشكاة بثمانية وعشرين لوحة من الرخام المخرم أو المنقوش. تتباين هذه الزخرفة الوفيرة مع إطار المشكاة الذي تغطيه زخرفة شطرنجية مكونة من مربعات من الفخار ذو البريق المعدني، والتي يرجع تأريخها إلى القرن 3 الهجري/ القرن 9 الميلادي والتي يرجح أن يكون منشأها عراقيا.  
يعتبر المنبر، وهو أيضاً من القرن 3 الهجري/ القرن 9 الميلادي، أقدم منبر إسلامي وصل إلينا. صنع هذا المنبر من أكثر من ثلاث مائة لوحة من خشب الدلب الهندي، تتداخل في منحوتاتها التأثيرات البيزنطية والرافدية. وتتواجد، إلى يمين المنبر، المقصورة، وهي قطعة أخرى من الخشب النفيس ترجع إلى المعز بن باديس (القرن 5 الهجري/ القرن 11 الميلادي)، وقد زخرفت بالخط الكوفي المزدان بالزهور.  
يضم الصحن المحاط بالأروقة قبة صغيرة ذات أخاديد تشير إلى محور المجاز القاطع، وهي من عمل أبي إبراهيم أحمد (247 هجري/862 ميلادي). وتشمخ في المقابل، وسط الجانب الشمالي، مئذنة طولها 32 متراً، تتكون من ثلاثة طبقات متوضعة فوق بعضها على قاعدة مربعة وتتوجها قبة ذات أخاديد، وهي منارة يذكر مظهرها المهيب بالمنارات الرومانية أو ببروج الأجراس السورية. وكذلك كان الأمر بالنسبة للسور الخارجي المتين الذي تدعمه مجموعة من الأبراج والبريجات البارزة، ودعامات ساندة عريضة، ويتم الولوج إليه عبر أبواب ذات مداخل مسقوفة. وإجمالا، يمثل جامع القيروان الكبير، بمقاييسه وأصالة عناصره المعمارية والزخرفية، واحداً من أكثر أمكنة العبادة روعة في الإسلام.

بني جامع القيروان الكبير فوق موضع أول مسجد إسلامي مشيد في بلاد المغارب من طرف عقبة ابن نافع؛ وجدد فيما بعد من قبل حسان ابن النعمان؛ ثم أعيد بناؤه كليا من طرق الأمير الأغلبي زيادة الله الأول.  
يعتبر الجامع الكبير بالقيروان أقدم وأروع مكان للعبادة في الغرب الإسلامي؛ وشكل نموذجه المعماري مثالا لأغلب المساجد الإفريقية (التونسية) حتى وصول العثمانيين. وبفضل تعدد أشكاله وغنى سجله الزخرفي الذي يوفق بين التأثيرات البيزنطية وتأثيرات بلاد مابين النهرين، يجسد هذا الجامع أهم عناصر المدرسة القيروانية.
history: ورث جامع القيروان الكبير موضع المصلى الإسلامي الأول في بلاد المغرب، والذي شيده في عام 50 هجري/670 ميلادي عقبة ابن نافع. وبعد إعادة تجديده التي قادها الحسن بن النعمان في عام 84 هجري/703 ميلادي، جرى توسيعه إبان حكم الوالي الأموي، بشر بن صفوان (103 -109 هجري/722 -728). وحصل تجديد آخر له خلال حكم يزيد بن هيثم في عام 155 هجري/773 ميلادي. وقد أعيد بناء الجامع بشكل كلي برعاية الأمير الأغلبي، زيادة الله، في عام 221 هجري/836 ميلادي، ليتخذ المسجد حينها أبعاده الحالية.
keywords: أموي؛ عباسي؛ حفصي؛ مقصورة؛ إفريز بنقوش كتابية؛ فن الخط؛ تأثيرات بيزنطية؛ تأثيرات رافدية؛ تيجان قديمة؛ قبوات ذات أخاديد؛ بريجات بارزة.
partner: Ministry of Culture, National Institute of Cultural Heritage

en.name: Great Mosque of Kairouan.
description:
Built on a rectangular plan 125 m long by 75 m wide, the edifice consists of a courtyard and a pillared hall 137 m x 37 m divided into 17 naves and 8 bays. The meeting of the central nave with the bay along the *qibla* wall forms a square area in front of the *mihrab*. Above this square rises a fluted dome mounted on carved stone squinches. These are decorated with scalloped and polyfoil rosette motifs inspired by the Umayyad repertoire. The great number of columns and ancient capitals in the prayer hall and in the galleries around the courtyard constitute the largest collection of Roman and Byzantine capitals in any Muslim monument or museum. In the wooden roof of the prayer hall some fine beams have been preserved, in spite of successive restorations in the AH 8th and 9th centuries (AD 14th and 15th). Dating back to the AH 3rd / AD 9th century, they are decorated in the Greek manner with spear-shaped fruit wrapped in symmetrical palm-leaves.  
The *mihrab*, which dates from the period of Abu Ibrahim Ahmed (AH 247 / AD 862), is covered by a painted wooden half-dome with foliate scrolls and five-lobed leaves. The niche has 28 panels of pierced or chased marble. This elaborate decoration contrasts with the surround of the niche which is covered in a chequer work of lustre ceramic tiles dating from the AH 3rd / AD 9th century and is probably of Iraqi origin.  
The *minbar*, also from the 3rd century AH (9th AD), is the oldest Muslim preacher's chair that we possess. It is made of more than 300 pieces of Indian teak. The wood-carving combines Byzantine and Mesopotamian influences. To the right of the *minbar*, the *maqsura*, another precious wooden piece dating back to al-Mu 'izz  
ibn Badis (5th century AH / 11th AD), has rich calligraphy in flowery *kufic*.  
The courtyard is surrounded by galleries and has a fluted dome at the centre of the narthex. This is the work of Abu Ibrahim Ahmed (247 AH / 862 AD). Opposite this, in the centre of the north side, the minaret rises to a height of 32 m. Built on a square base it is built in three stages and capped with a fluted dome. Its robust proportions are reminiscent of some Roman lighthouses or Syrian bell-towers. The external wall is just as strong, with many towers and bastions, held up with wide buttresses. There are several gates with porches. Given its size and the authenticity of its architectural and decorative elements, The Great Mosque at Kairouan represents one of the most prestigious places of worship in Islam.

Erected on the site of the first Islamic oratory built in the Maghreb by ‘Uqba ibn Nafi, the Great Mosque of Kairouan was later renovated by Hassan ibn Nu’man before being entirely rebuilt by the Aghlabid prince Ziyadat Allah I.  
It is the oldest and most prestigious place of worship in the Muslim West, and was used as the architectural model for most of the mosques built in Ifriqiya before the arrival of the Ottomans. With its variety of forms and the wealth of its decorative repertoire, which combines Byzantine and Mesopotamian influences, it embodies most facets of the Kairouanese school.
history: The Great Mosque at Kairouan inherited the site of the first Muslim oratory in the Maghreb, which was built by ‘Uqba ibn Nafi in 50 (670). After renovations conducted by Hasan ibn Nu'man in 84 (703), enlargements under the governor Bichr ibn Safwan (103–9 / 722–8), and another renovation under Yazid ibn Hatim in 155 (772), the mosque was totally rebuilt by the Aghlabid prince Ziyadat Allah I in 221 (836), when it assumed its current dimensions.
keywords: Umayyad; Abbasid; Hafsid; maqsura; epigraphic frieze; Byzantine influences; Mesopotamian influence; antique capitals
partner: Ministry of Culture, National Institute of Cultural Heritage

es.name: Mezquita Mayor.
description:
El edificio se inscribe en un rectángulo de 125 m de largo por 75 m de ancho. Se compone de un patio y de una sala hipóstila (137 x 37 m), dividida en diecisiete naves dispuestas en ocho tramos. El cruce de la nave axial con la galería paralela al muro de la *qibla* configura un cuadrado delante del *mihrab*. Este cuadrado está coronado por una cúpula acanalada sobre trompas, en piedra esculpida, cuyos motivos decorativos de conchas y rosetones polilobulados se inspiran en el repertorio omeya. El considerable número de columnas y capiteles antiguos de la sala de oración y de las galerías que rodean el patio constituye la mayor colección de capiteles romanos y bizantinos jamás reunida en un monumento o museo islámico tunecino. La techumbre con armadura de madera de la sala de oración ha conservado, a pesar de las sucesivas restauraciones de los siglos VIII / XIV y XI / XVII, bonitas vigas que se remontan al siglo III / IX. Su decoración vegetal, compuesta de frutos lanceolados envueltos en palmetas simétricas, es de inspiración helenística.  
El *mihrab*, que data de la época de Abu Ibrahim Ahmad (247 / 862), está coronado por semicúpulas de madera pintada de follaje y hojas de cinco lóbulos. El nicho está recubierto con 28 paneles de mármol calado o tallados en hueco, que muestran una decoración compuesta por una amplia variedad de motivos florales y geométricos. Esta profusa decoración contrasta con el marco del nicho, revestido con una colección única de 139 azulejos de reflejo metálico, que datan del siglo XIII / IX, probablemente de origen iraquí.  
El *minbar*, también del siglo III / IX, constituye el más antiguo púlpito que haya llegado hasta nosotros. Está hecho con más de 300 paneles de madera de teca india. Las esculturas sobre madera combinan la influencia bizantina y mesopotámica. A la derecha del *minbar*, la *maqsura*, otra pieza en madera preciosa, que data de la época del zirí al-Muizz ibn Badis (siglo V / XI), presenta un friso epigráfico con caligrafía en cúfico florido.  
El patio, rodeado de galerías, muestra una cúpula acanalada que marca el eje del nártex, obra de Abu Ibrahim Ahmad (247 / 862). Enfrente, en medio del lado norte, se eleva el alminar, de 32 m de altura. Sobre una base cuadrada, tres niveles superpuestos están coronados por una cúpula gallonada. Su aire robusto y sobrio evoca algunos faros romanos o campanarios sirios. Igual de robusto es su recinto exterior, erizado de torres y bastiones, sostenido por grandes contrafuertes y dotado de ocho puertas con sus porches.  
Por sus dimensiones y debido a la autenticidad de sus elementos arquitectónicos y decorativos, la Mezquita Mayor de Kairuán representa uno de los más prestigiosos lugares de culto del Islam.

Edificada en el emplazamiento del primer oratorio musulmán construido en el Magreb por Uqba ibn Nafi, la mezquita fue renovada por Hasan ibn Numan y, más tarde, totalmente reconstruida por el príncipe aglabí Ziyadat Allah I.  
La Mezquita Mayor de Kairuán representa el más antiguo y prestigioso lugar de culto en el Occidente musulmán. Su modelo arquitectónico sirvió de ejemplo a la mayoría de las mezquitas de Ifriqiya, hasta la llegada de los otomanos. Por la diversidad de sus formas y la riqueza de su repertorio ornamental, que combina influencias bizantinas y mesopotámicas, encarna lo esencial de los elementos de la escuela kairuaní.
history: La Mezquita Mayor heredó el emplazamiento del primer oratorio musulmán del Magreb, edificado por Uqba ibn Nafi en 50 / 670. Después de una renovación llevada a cabo por Hasan ibn Numan en 84 / 703, de una ampliación realizada bajo el gobierno omeya de Bishr ibn Safwan (103-109 / 722-728) y de otra renovación por Yazid ibn Hatim en 155 / 772, la mezquita fue totalmente reconstruida por orden del príncipe aglabí Ziyadat Allah I en el año 221 / 836. De entonces datan su morfología y sus medidas actuales.
keywords: omeya; abbasí; hafsí; maqsura; friso epigráfico; influencia bizantina; influencia mesopotámica; capiteles de la Antigüedad
partner: Ministry of Culture, National Institute of Cultural Heritage

fr.name: Grande Mosquée de Kairouan.
description:
L'édifice s'inscrit dans un rectangle de 125 m de longueur et 75 m de largeur. Il est composé d'une cour et d'une salle hypostyle de 137 x 37 m, divisée en 17 nefs et 8 travées. La rencontre de la nef axiale et de la travée longeant le mur de la *qibla* détermine un carré au devant du *mihrab*. Ce carré est surmonté d'une coupole cannelée sur trompes en pierre sculptée dont les motifs en coquilles et rosaces polylobées s'inspirent du répertoire omeyyade. Le nombre considérable de colonnes et de chapiteaux antiques de la salle de prière et des galeries encadrant la cour constitue le plus grand musée de chapiteaux romains et byzantins jamais réunis dans un monument musulman. La couverture en charpente de bois de la salle de prière a conservé, malgré les restaurations successives aux VIIIe et XIe siècles H (XIVe et XVIIe siècles J.-C), de belles poutres remontant au IIIe siècle H (IXe siècle J.-C.). Leur décor végétal, composé d'un fruit lancéolé enveloppé de palmes symétriques, est d'inspiration hellénistique.  
  
Le *mihrab*, qui date de l'époque de Abou Ibrahim Ahmed (247 H / 862 J.-C.), est coiffé d'une demi-coupole en bois peint de rinceaux et de feuilles à cinq lobes. La niche est meublée de 28 panneaux de marbre ajouré ou champlevé. Ce décor foisonnant contraste avec le cadre de la niche recouvert d'un damier de carreaux de céramique à reflets métalliques, datables du IIIe siècle H (IXe siècle J.-C.) et probablement d'origine irakienne.  
  
Le *minbar*, également du IIIe siècle H (IXe siècle J.-C.), constitue la plus ancienne chaire à prêcher musulmane qui nous soit parvenue. Elle est faite de plus de 300 panneaux en bois de teck indien. Les sculptures sur bois combinent les influences byzantines et mésopotamiennes. À droite du *minbar*, la *maqsoura*, autre pièce en bois précieux remontant à al-Mouiz ibn Badis (Ve siècle H / XIe siècle J.-C), s'enrichit d'une calligraphie en coufique fleuri.  
  
La cour entourée de galeries présente une coupole cannelée marquant l'axe de la galerie-narthex, œuvre de Abou Ibrahim Ahmed (247 H / 862 J.-C). En vis-à-vis, au centre du côté nord, se dresse le minaret de 32 m de hauteur. Sur une base carrée, trois étages superposés sont couronnés d'une coupole à cannelures. Son allure robuste n'est pas sans rappeler quelques phares romains ou clochers syriens. Tout aussi robuste est l'enceinte extérieure, hérissée de tours et de bastions, soutenue de larges contreforts et percée de portes avec des porches. Par ses dimensions et par l'authenticité de ses éléments architectoniques et décoratifs, la Grande Mosquée de Kairouan représente l'un des plus prestigieux lieux de culte de l'Islam.

Bâtie sur l'emplacement du premier oratoire musulman édifié au Maghreb par Okba ibn Nafi, la Grande Mosquée de Kairouan est ensuite rénovée par Hassan ibn Nooman, puis totalement reconstruite par le prince aghlabide Ziyadat Allah Ier.  
La Grande Mosquée de Kairouan représente le plus ancien et le plus prestigieux lieu de culte dans l'Occident musulman. Son modèle architectural a servi d'exemple pour la plupart des mosquées ifriqiyennes jusqu'à l'arrivée des Ottomans. Par la diversité de ses formes et la richesse de son répertoire ornemental qui combine les influences byzantines et mésopotamiennes, elle incarne l'essentiel des éléments de l'école kairouanaise.
history: La Grande Mosquée de Kairouan a hérité de l'emplacement du premier oratoire musulman au Maghreb, édifié par Oqba ibn Nafi en 50/670. Après une rénovation conduite par Hassan ibn Nooman en 84/703 puis un agrandissement sous le gouverneur omeyyade Bichr ibn Safouane (103-109/722-728) et une autre rénovation sous Yazid ibn Hatem en 155/772, la mosquée est totalement reconstruite par les soins du prince aghlabide Ziyadat Allah Ier en 221/836. C'est alors qu'elle prit ses dimensions actuelles.
keywords: Omeyyade; abbasside; hafside; maqsoura; frise épigraphique; influences byzantines; influences mésopotamiennes; chapiteaux antiques.
partner: Ministry of Culture, National Institute of Cultural Heritage

en.name: Caucasian Dragon Rug
description:
Caucasian carpets dominate the carpet auction of the Ernst Museum, and the most remarkable of  
these are the Armenian carpets. Armenian rug number 31, for example, could be the pride of any  
museum. Its bold ornamentation and distinctive colouring make it a true masterpiece. Its surface is  
adorned by dragons surrounded by large leaves, large palmettes, birds and lions struggling with  
chamois. It has been dated to the late 16th or early 17th century.  
  
We do not know who was selling the carpet at that time or who bought it, but six years later, in 1924, it appeared in the unillustrated descriptive list of the Museum of Applied Arts’ *Early Oriental Carpets* exhibition, marked as the property of a very sophisticated art collector, Zoltán Mauthner (1880‒1936), the co-proprietor of the leather company Gebrüder Mauthner und Co. He probably purchased the carpet at the 1918 Ernst auction. He exhibited it in 1924 and sold it together with other items in his collection either at an auction or via an art dealer around 1930. That may have been when Mrs. Endler acquired it.
keywords: Caucasus; Dragon; Wool
materials: Warp and weft: 2 shoots; Pile: Wool; Symmetrical knot. Its edges are missing, the repairs are inconsistent, and gaps have been made up with parts cut out from other carpets.
tags: Symmetrical knot. Its edges are missing, the repairs are inconsistent, and gaps have been made up with parts cut out from other carpets.

de.name:
Stiftskirche Wilhering  
Stiftskirche der Zisterzienser in Wilhering
description:
Als große Ausnahme in Österreich entwickelte sich Rokoko in Oberösterreich wesentlich stärker als in den anderen Bundesländern. Der Einfluss kam aus dem nahen Bayern, wo sich der neue Stil großer Popularität erfreute.  
Nach dem Brand im 18. Jahrhundert erhielt die (romanische) Kirche eine barocke Fassade und ein Rokoko-Interieur. Interessanterweise gab es weder ein künstlerisches Gesamtkonzept noch eine Leitung der Ausstattungsarbeiten. Fresken, Stuckornamente (zwei Phasen und Teams) und Innengestaltung entstanden (meist) nacheinander, und ergaben – überraschenderweise – ein harmonisches Gesamtkunstwerk.

Gemäß einer Zisterzienser Tradition ist die Kirche der Jungfrau Maria geweiht, beinahe jedes Kunstwerk bezieht sich auf das Leben der Muttergottes.  
Obwohl es keinen Gesamtplan für die Gestaltung des Kircheninnenraums gab, gelang es Architekten, Künstlern und Handwerkern, ein Rokoko-Gesamtwerk zu erschaffen, das den Betrachter anleitet, nicht die Details anzusehen, sondern das große Ganze, das den Rokoko-Effekt erzeugt.
dates:
1733-1750 nach einem Brand Wiederaufbau der Kirche  
1738-1743 Altargemälde  
1739-1741 Stuckdekoration Langhaus  
1739?-1741 Fresken Langhaus Decke  
1742-1751 Stuckdekoration Altarraum und Querschiffe  
1747 Beginn Vergoldungsarbeiten
dynasty: Barock und Rokoko (auf romanischem Grundriss und unter Einbeziehung romanischer Langhaus-, Querschiff- und Altarraum-Wände)
artist: Im 12. Jahrhundert verwendeten Ulrich und Cholo von Wilhering einen Teil des väterlichen Erbes zur Gründung eines Stifts. Nach Ulrichs Tod übertrug Cholo die Stiftung dem Zisterzienserorden.

Architektur: Johann Haslinger (1701-1741), vielleicht nach Plänen von Joseph Matthias Götz (1696-1760); Innengestaltung: Andrea Altomonte? (1699-1780); alle Altarbilder: Martino Altomonte (1657-1745); Fresken (Figuren): Bartolomeo Altomonte (1694-1783); Fresken (Architektur): Francesco Messenta (1675-1745); Stuck Langhaus: Franz Joseph Ignaz Holzinger (1691-1775); Stuck Querschiffe und Altarraum, Orgel-Figuren und Statuen: Johann Georg Üblherr; Stuck Querschiffe und Altarraum (Ornamente): Johann Michael Feichtmayr (1703-1763); Vergoldung: Johann Georg Früholz (+ 1775)
history:
Als die Zisterzienser im Mittelalter nach Wilhering kamen, werden sie zuerst in einem weltlichen Vorgängerbau gewohnt haben. Bald begannen sie, Klostergebäude und eine Kirche zu errichten. Sie erhielten weitere Stiftungsgelder, und das Kloster erreichte eine wirtschaftliche Hochblüte.  
Während der Türkeneinfälle, der Reformation und nach dem großen Brand im 18. Jahrhundert durchlebten die Mönche schwere Zeiten. Obwohl sie keine Mittel hatten, begann Abt Johann IV – zunächst bescheiden – mit dem Wiederaufbau der Kirche. Im Lauf der Zeit geriet sie immer prächtiger, und so dauerte es eine Weile, bis die Schulden abbezahlt waren. Der Aufwand lohnte sich aber, denn die Kirche gilt heute als eines der bedeutendsten sakralen Rokoko-Gebäude Österreichs.

en.name:
Wilhering Abbey Church  
Cistercian Abbey Church in Wilhering
names: Abbey Church of the Assumption of Mary in Wilhering
description:
Rococo developed more intensely in Upper Austria than in the other states of the country. The influence came from nearby Bavaria where the new style enjoyed an immense popularity.  
After the fire in the 18th century the (Romanesque) church got a Baroque façade and a Rococo interior. Interestingly, there was no artistic concept nor a leading overall designer. Fresco paintings, stucco work (two different phases and teams) and fittings were (mostly) done one after the other, and – surprisingly – harmonize as a total work of art.

In accordance with a Cistercian tradition, the church is dedicated to the Virgin Mary: almost every artwork is in context of the life of the Mother of God.  
Even as there was no masterplan for the church’s interior, designers, artists and craftsmen accomplished therewith a Rococo entity of architecture and art. The viewer is being inspired not to only see the details, but the whole work that produces the Rococo effect.
dates:
1733–50 reconstruction of church after a fire  
1738–43 altar paintings  
1739–41 stucco decoration nave  
1739?–41 fresco painting ceiling nave  
1742–51 stucco decoration sanctuary and transepts  
1747 start of gilding work
dynasty: Baroque and Rococo (on Romanesque floor plan and incorporating the Romanesque nave’s, transepts’ and sanctuary’s walls)
artist: In the 12th century Ulrich and Cholo of Wilhering donated a part of their father’s inheritance to the foundation of a monastery. After Ulrich’s death Cholo transferred the foundation to the Cistercian order.

Architecture: Johann Haslinger (1701–41), presumably after plans by Joseph Matthias Götz (1696–1760); interior overall design: Andrea Altomonte? (1699–1780); altar paintings: Martino Altomonte (1657–1745); fresco paintings (figural part): Bartolomeo Altomonte (1694–1783); fresco paintings (architecture): Francesco Messenta (1675–1745); stucco nave: Franz Joseph Ignaz Holzinger (1691–1775); stucco transepts and choir, organ figures and statues: Johann Georg Üblherr (1703–63) and Johann Michael Feichtmayr (1709–72); gilding: Johann Georg Früholz (died 1775)
history:
When the Cistercians came to Wilhering in the Middle Ages they would have lived in a previous secular building. Soon they erected monastery buildings and a church. They got further endowments and the monastery was flourishing.  
During the Turkish invasions, the Reformation and after the big fire in the 18th century the monks went through hard times. Though there were no funds, abbot Johann IV started – modestly – with the reconstruction of the church. As time went by, it became more and more magnificent, and it took a while to pay off the debts. But it was well worth it as the church became one of the most important ecclesiastical Rococo buildings in Austria.
